name: timeline-estimation
description: Timeline estimation for a project, release, or initiative using three-point (PERT), analogous, parametric, and velocity-based techniques. Integrates with dependency-mapping for critical-path timelines. Produces optimistic / most-likely / pessimistic date ranges, schedule contingency recommendations, milestone plan, sensitivity against top duration drivers, and Mermaid Gantt plus range diagrams with optional PNG export.
